request: Analyze GSE123961 for PMID 33275875 (ROS Dynamics Delineate Functional States of Hippocampal Neural Stem Cells and Link to Their Activity-Dependent Exit from Quiescence.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (SMARTer) of FACS-sorted Nes-GFP+ precursor cells
experiments_sequenced: Experiment 1: Nes-GFP+ cells from DG vs SVZ of the same standard-housed animals (S2.2.p1, S4.4.10.1.p1) -> GSE123961
Experiment 2: DG Nes-GFP+ cells sorted by ROS class (hi/mid/loROS) from standard-housed animals (S2.3.p1, S4.4.10.1.p1) -> other SubSeries
final.primary_estimand: For GSE123961: region-specific transcription (DG vs SVZ) in Nes-GFP+ precursors of standard-housed mice. No exercise estimand is sequenced; running-wheel effects (S2.1, S2.6) are measured only by BrdU/IdU counts, flow-cytometric ROS and western blot.
planned_contrasts: DG vs SVZ 'enriched'/'signature' transcripts (S4.4.11.p1; Table S1) - not an exercise contrast
final.housing: all sequenced animals standard housed (S2.2.p1, S4.4.10.1.p1; GEO growth_protocol 'Standard housing')
final.sample_exclusion: one low-depth sample per experiment removed (S4.4.11.p1)
final.paper_method: edgeR CPM filter (>=1 CPM in 75% of one group) then limma lmFit/topTags (S4.4.11.p1)
final.paper_results: Table S1 (DG/SVZ enriched transcripts); count not stated in text

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The paper's two RNA-seq experiments both use standard-housed mice (S4.4.10.1.p1: 'standard housed animals' in both). Exercise (running wheel 1-5 nights) appears only in histology/flow/western experiments (S2.1.p1-p2, S2.6.p1, S4.4.16.p1). GSE123961 is the DG vs SVZ subseries.

checks: SubSeries of GSE124095 named in S4.2.3.p1

ownership.reasoning: GEO series record links PMID 33275875 and is a SubSeries of GSE124095 cited in the paper's data availability (S4.2.3.p1).

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns L#### are the prefix of the GEO title ('L4799: SVZ_STD_POS1'); tissue derived from title. All titles carry STD (standard housing).

matrix.matrix_type: log2 CPM (edgeR cpm, low-expression filtered), normalized expression
matrix.reasoning: Non-integer values from -5.1 to 14.1 with median 4.3; GEO data_processing: 'Counts per million (cpm) calculated using EdgeR and low-expressed genes discarded'; supplementary format 'normalised expression'. Consistent with log2 CPM.

candidates.reason_rejected: Region comparison in standard-housed mice; not an exercise contrast. Running it would manufacture an exercise estimand the data cannot identify.

design.stop_reason: No exercise arm: all 9 samples are standard-housed (title *_STD_*, growth_protocol 'Standard housing'; paper S4.4.10.1.p1). The only factor is tissue (DG 5 / SVZ 4). The paper's exercise effects are measured by cell counts, flow cytometry and westerns, not RNA-seq.
design.reasoning: The requested estimand (effect of exercise on gene expression) is not identifiable from GSE123961.

discrepancies.paper: running-wheel paradigms (S2.1, S2.6) assessed by BrdU/IdU, DHE flow cytometry, western blot
discrepancies.data: GSE123961 samples all standard housed, DG vs SVZ only
